stemMd: What does “withstand” mean in the final sentence?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Remain able to preserve or recover the collection despite specified failures.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Predict the exact date of every failure.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Store files only while no one opens them.

explanationMd: The archive describes which failures it can survive while retaining recoverable data. “Withstand” concerns resistance to consequences, not perfect forecasting or elimination of all hazards.

distractorRationale.d: Resilience does not require exact prediction.
distractorRationale.a: The arrangements reduce consequences rather than abolish hazards.
distractorRationale.e: That is not the resilience concept described.
distractorRationale.c: The archive aims to preserve the files themselves.
